note: USACE Truman Lake campground on a wooded peninsula, in two loops. B Loop's seven full-hookup sites are in the woods away from the lake. C Loop fills the peninsula tip; its south-end sites (about 49-60) sit on open grass with scattered trees looking toward the lake. Boat ramp, playground, and hiking and horse trails. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with changes: season Mar 1 - Nov 30 (was seasonal, no dates); fees $14-40 with peak/off-peak spans (high was $35, missed B Loop's $40); 91 sites, max 75 ft, all back-in; facilities incl. laundry and dump; weekend/holiday minimums from the posted notice. Lakeview kept (C Loop south end). PIN 1.6 km off - move to the C Loop. Phone to add.
flags: PIN: stored 38.1997,-93.5100 is the rec.gov facility point, ~1.6 km north of the C Loop and ~800 m north of the B Loop (it sits between the group shelters GR001/GR002 and the entrance road). Suggest 38.1854,-93.5121 (centroid of the 84 C Loop site points, on the loop roads).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview): kept, earned only by C Loop's south end. Measured on leaf-off imagery taken with the lake drawn down: sites ~49-60 sit on open grass with scattered trees, ~50-80 m from the normal-pool shoreline (the vegetation line) of the south cove and the peninsula tip, with a footpath between - an open sightline, but not an apron at the water at normal pool, so lakefront not earned (unsure = down to view). West-side sites 89-94 are 70-90 m from the shore through woods; east-end sites 12-14 are ~110-135 m away; B Loop (7 sites) is in the woods with no water nearby except a fenced lagoon. No rec.gov 'Proximity to Water' value (N/A on 34 sites, absent on the rest).
PHONE: rec.gov lists 660-438-3872 for the campground; the entry has no phone - suggest adding it.
ELECTRIC: rec.gov's description says C Loop 'Sites 39-78 are 50-amp with water', but the catalog types those sites 30 amp (only B002-B008 are 50). The 50 in hookups rests on B Loop either way.
MIN STAY: written from the campground's posted notice; recreation.gov's rule fields minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay are 0, so the booking system may not enforce it - stated in booking.note.
FIT: every overnight site permits RV/Trailer/Tent with lengths 50-75 ft.
